selected_cover_prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset: premium literary speculative novel cover ART, portrait 2:3, highest native detail. Title and author will be typeset separately. A woman is being physically CONSTRUCTED FROM DOCUMENTS, not a real woman covered with a texture. Clearly recognizable modern archival source materials: typed correspondence, ruled records, annotations, form grids, occasional black redaction bars, photograph contact-sheet fragments. Distinct rectangular sheets, folded corners, thin fibrous page edges, black carbon copies, largely clean ivory paper; avoid crumbly rock, mummies, decayed parchment, generic origami. Across cheek, eyelid, nose and lips, paper folds themselves form the anatomy; no painted skin over papers. Scholarly and emotionally human, quiet intelligence and ambiguity. Near-black, caliche ivory, warm gray, scarce ember light. Sculptural editorial realism with tactile fine detail and powerful silhouette, no sci-fi neon, robot, circuitry, fantasy particles, glowing eye, gothic horror, skull, flowers, keys or lanterns. Page text should read as typeset document texture, no large legible slogans. No title, caption, watermark or border. Top 22% quiet dark negative space for typography; bottom 10% quiet for author. The image should remain clear at book-thumbnail size. Reference image 1: prior cover, retain the archival-human premise but radically change composition. Show an upright head-and-shoulders woman in three-quarter view, face turned slightly toward the viewer. At bottom, a loose stack of unbound records rests in darkness. A continuous rising fan of individual typed pages joins that stack to the torso, neck and head: at the bottom they are flat documents; through the shoulders they bend and interlock; at the face they become exquisitely precise human anatomy. This transformation is the entire composition. A few page corners remain lifted along her cheek. The outer silhouette is strong black, with ivory seams and one thoughtful eye built from overlapping paper, not a realistic eyeball. Nothing resembles wings or feathers. No vortex or magic. Grounded impossible paper engineering, the whole person visibly manufactured by what was kept.
